title: BlockMetadata
description: Catalog entry for one functional block. One file per block under packages/blocks/src/blocks/<family>/<block_dir>/metadata.yaml. Shared contract: the frontend reads visual + search fields; the simulator reads behavior + equation_template. See docs/specs/frontend-spec.md §9 and progress.yaml FE-23.

name.description: Catalog key in dotted canonical form such as `control.gain` or `source.voltage.pulse`. Stable across releases — renaming breaks every saved model that uses the block.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the library tree, Quick Insert results, and block headers on the canvas.

type.description: v2 catalog type string, such as `physical-electrical.passive.resistor`. When omitted, `name` is also the catalog type.

version.description: Block metadata schema version. v1 is the only valid value today; bump only when adding required fields.

category.description: Top-level category for the library tree. This is the frontend-visible grouping and may differ from the intermediate directory layout for some families.

description.description: One-line description used in Quick Insert tooltip and the block tooltip on hover.

icon.description: Optional icon asset used by lightweight v2 catalog entries.

paradigm.description: Top-level modeling paradigm used by .gsim_sch v2 blocks and catalog filtering.

domain.description: Primary v2 port domain for this block family.

fidelities.description: Per-fidelity port and parameter contract used by the fidelity-swap UI and .gsim_sch v2 block insertion.

aliases.description: Alternate searchable names (e.g. "Proportional-Integral-Derivative" for PID). Boosts fuzzy-match recall.

tags.description: Keywords for filtering and ranking. Free-form, but conventions emerge (e.g. `feedback`, `nonlinear`, `discrete`).

variadic_inputs.description: Optional: input ports whose count is determined by a parameter (e.g. the Sum block's signs string). The frontend instantiates one port per element of the controlling param.

count_from.description: Name of the param that controls input count. The param must be of type string, vector, or integer.

variadic_outputs.description: Optional: output ports whose count is determined by a parameter (e.g. a script block's output_names vector). The frontend instantiates one port per element of the controlling param, exactly as for variadic_inputs.

count_from.description: Name of the param that controls output count. The param must be of type string, vector, or integer.

ports.description: Port declarations. Coordinates are in block-local frame; rotation/mirror are applied by the renderer at draw time.

params.description: Parameter declarations. Listed in display order in the Property Inspector.

bbox.description: Symbol bounding box `[width, height]` in canvas units (integer). Ports are positioned along the bbox edges via `side` + `offset`.

shape.description: Symbol geometry. `rect` is the default block; `circle` for summing junctions; `triangle` for gain/amplifier; `custom` uses `path`; `primitives` (GSF) uses a literal `primitives` array for multi-shape drawings.

path.description: SVG path `d=` attribute, required when `shape == custom`. Coordinates in block-local frame (origin top-left of bbox).

primitives.description: GSF (Gsim Symbol Format) primitive list, required when `shape == primitives`. See docs/specs/gsim-symbol-format-spec.md.

text.description: Optional text rendered inside the symbol (e.g. "PID", "1/s"). May reference a param value via `{paramName}` interpolation.

svg_viewbox.description: Original SVG viewBox [width, height]. Required when ports use svg_x/svg_y positioning.

symbol.description: How the block is drawn. The renderer reads `bbox` to lay out ports; `shape` + `path` + `text` for the body.

causality.description: `source`: 0 inputs, n outputs. `causal`: inputs determine outputs. `acausal`: equation-based (no fixed direction). `sink`: n inputs, 0 outputs.

domain.description: Primary modelling domain. `mixed` blocks bridge two domains (e.g. a current sensor with electrical pins and a signal output).

state_count.description: Number of internal state variables. Use `"dynamic"` when count depends on a param (e.g. transfer-function order from `den` polynomial length).

equation_template.description: Reference to the simulator-side equation template (resolved by the `packages/simulator/` lowering stage). Conventionally equals `name` and may contain multiple dotted segments, but is kept separate so a block can be renamed without breaking its template binding.

behavior.description: Solver-facing metadata. The frontend uses `causality` to lay out ports; the simulator uses all four fields during IR-1 → IR-2 lowering.

main_param.description: Name of the param targeted by Alt+Enter ("set main parameter"). Must match an entry in `params[]`. Omit if no param is the obvious primary edit target.

port_sigs.description: Port dimension signatures for FE-65 signal-dimension propagation. Keys are port ids (wildcards like 'in*' allowed); values are one of: '[N]' (literal dim), 'inherit', 'from(<portId>)', 'sum(<portPattern>)', 'partition(<portId>, <param>)', 'shape(<param>)', 'bus'.

allOf.description: If main_param is set, it must reference an existing param. Enforced at runtime by the catalog loader (FE-23). The params array is already required at the root level; this allOf entry is reserved for future cross-field constraints.

Primitive.description: GSF (Gsim Symbol Format) primitive — mirrors the Primitive union in apps/frontend/src/canvas/nodes/primitive-renderer.ts field-for-field. Coordinates are integers in block-local space, origin top-left of symbol.bbox.

rotation.description: Degrees, about the shape's own center. Optional, defaults to 0 (unrotated) when absent.
Degrees, about the shape's own center. Optional, defaults to 0 (unrotated) when absent.
Degrees. A circle is rotation-invariant visually; kept for schema symmetry with rect/rectf/text, not rendered as a visible effect.
Degrees, about the text's own anchor point (x, y). Optional, defaults to 0 (unrotated) when absent.

id.description: Stable port identifier; used by every connection in every saved model. Renaming breaks every model that uses this block.

label.description: Short label rendered next to the port (e.g. "e" for PID error input). Empty string for no label.

side.description: Which side of the bbox the port emerges from in the unrotated, unmirrored block. Rotation/mirror are applied by the renderer.

offset.description: Distance along the chosen side, in canvas units, from the top-left corner of the bbox (top/bottom: from left edge; left/right: from top edge).

svg_x.description: X coordinate in the symbol SVG viewBox space. When combined with svg_y and symbol.svg_viewbox, overrides side+offset for port position.

svg_y.description: Y coordinate in the symbol SVG viewBox space.

name.description: Stable param identifier; persisted in every saved model. Renaming breaks every model that uses this block.

label.description: Human-readable label rendered in the Property Inspector.

type.description: Param value type. The inspector renders one editor per type (NumberInput, VectorInput, Dropdown, etc. — see FE-26).

default.description: Default value used when a block is inserted. Must match `type`. Validation is done by the catalog loader, not the schema (cross-field type rules are awkward in pure JSON Schema).

min.description: Inclusive lower bound for numeric / vector elements. Inspector flags violations as warnings.

max.description: Inclusive upper bound for numeric / vector elements.
